messages:
sam: Heads up — canary dashboards show a ~2x sampling bump for the new client feature. Looks like the client + proxy are both sampling the same requests, so console attribution is doubled.

maya: ugh. can you paste the request headers / quick repro?

sam: repro steps: run local proxy + py-sdk v0.15-canary and hit chat endpoint. curl trace:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -H 'X-RDWD-CLIENT-SAMPLE: 1' -H 'X-RDWD-PROXY-SAMPLED: true' https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat
```
Both client and proxy are setting sample headers.

owen: we flipped the proxy-side sampler yesterday (opt-out -> opt-in for some routes). client opt-in was supposed to be mutually exclusive but canary has client opt-in enabled. proxy should honor client header and not set its own — looks like our honor flag defaulted wrong.

lin: is this purely console-level (metrics/attribution) or does it affect billing/ingest too?

sam: billing pipeline dedups later so costs are okay for now, but console per-route burn + per-tenant token graphs are wrong which is confusing for customers during canary.

jordan: quick mitigation: server can ignore proxy-injected sample header if X-RDWD-SAMPLE-ORIGIN=proxy and X-RDWD-CLIENT-SAMPLE present. also pushing small SDK patches to stop injecting when RDWD_CLIENT_SAMPLER=disabled.

deploy-bot: deploy proxy-canary v2026.03.23-rc1 -> success (1749995120) :white_check_mark:

owen: low-risk change — can flip proxy to a mode that defers to client header. doing a soft rollback guard to avoid flipping it for >5% of tenants at once.

maya: can we add a console toggle that shows "deduped sampling" vs raw so SREs can verify quickly? also need a short docs blurb for the canary.

lin: I’ll add a console feature flag and a small UI note in the metrics tile.

jordan: PRs up for SDKs: py-sdk#1234 (stop inject), ts-sdk#5678 (opt-in flag), leaving Go for next patch. assigning reviews to @owen.

sam: owner list: owen (proxy guard), jordan (sdk patches), lin/maya (console toggle + doc). recon in #eng-platform at 14:00 to validate dashboards after the proxy flip.

maya: thanks — added a short blurb in docs draft and a link to the PRs. :thumbsup:

jordan: TL;DR — root cause: duplicate sampling headers from client+proxy => console double-count. short-term: proxy defers to client OR server ignores proxy-origin header if client header present. mid-term: SDK config default change + console toggle + docs.

sam: marking follow-up checklist in tracker and closing thread when dashboards look correct. :white_check_mark:
